name: Gfx_WaitRetraceBit
comment: loops until VGA status bit 3 is set; returns at once inside a retrace

name: Intro_FadeIn
comment: DAC 1..255 := g_Palette * level div 64 for level 0..64; one retrace wait per level (flow/intro.md 4.2)

name: Txt_DrawGlyph
signature: void near pascal(X: Integer; Y: Integer; Ch: Byte; Color: Byte; Flag: Byte)

name: Txt_DrawStringSpaced
signature: void near pascal(X: Integer; Y: Integer; var S: String; Color: Byte)
comment: text A: small-font string with one extra pixel before every character but x/y (flyover captions)

name: Txt_DrawString
signature: void near pascal(X: Integer; Y: Integer; var S: String; Color: Byte)
comment: text B: small-font string as file0001 Txt_DrawString; ^ = raised 2

name: Intro_Hold
comment: waits until DOS time > g_TPrev + 50 n or a key is waiting (16-bit timestamp; OB-034)

name: Intro_Main
comment: whole intro: date card; intro0 narration; flyover; intro1; intro2; exit (flow/intro.md)

name: WORX_SetVoiceVolume
signature: word far pascal(Left: Byte; Right: Byte)

name: WORX_SetFmVolume
signature: word far pascal(Left: Byte; Right: Byte)

name: WORX_SbInit
comment: driver fn 01h; result in g_SbCard (FFFFh = none)

name: WORX_MusicPlaying
comment: driver fn 0Eh; polled every flyover step (U-370)

name: Gfx_DrawSpriteFlipped
signature: void far pascal(X: Word; Y: Word; Sprite: Byte; Page: Byte)
comment: 32x32 td.shp record; vertically flipped; reads one column right (OB-059); y low byte only (OB-058); 0 transparent

name: Gfx_ClearPage
signature: void far pascal(Offset: Word; Width: Word; Page: Byte)

name: Gfx_SetDac
signature: void far pascal(Index: Byte; R: Byte; G: Byte; B: Byte)

name: Gfx_DrawTile
signature: void far pascal(Col: Byte; Row: Byte; Tile: Byte; Page: Byte)
comment: latched copy from VGA B580h + 256 tile

name: Gfx_InitUnchained
comment: mode 13h; DAC all black; unchained; VGA memory cleared

name: Gfx_PutPixel
signature: void far pascal(X: Word; Y: Word; Color: Byte)
comment: byte (Y*88 + X div 4) mod 65536 of plane X mod 4

name: RandSeed
comment: starts at 0; Randomize is never called

name: g_Music
comment: 1 none / 2 FM (td.cfg byte 0 or detection or switch)

name: g_Sfx
comment: 1 none / 2 SB / 3 speaker (td.cfg byte 1 or detection or switch)

name: g_TPrev
comment: DOS time of the last tick or hold start (4 words)

name: g_SfxFlag
comment: one-shot flag of the scratch rules (flow/intro.md 3.6)

name: g_LastKey
comment: last key read at a key check

name: g_ScrStrip
comment: 7 image rows saved for erasing narration lines

name: g_SkidY
comment: hoverskid y (page coordinates; screen y = value - 16)
